description: This file defines the DoctorProvider class, which manages a list of doctors, including fetching data from an API, handling errors, and notifying listeners in a Flutter application.

classes.name: DoctorProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of doctors, handles API calls, authentication logout on authorization failure, and maintains loading/error states.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Getter for the list of fetched doctors.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter indicating if a fetch operation is in progress.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Getter for current error message, if any.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Associates AuthProvider and ApiClient instances with the provider and marks dependencies as ready.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Internal method to update loading state and notify listeners.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Asynchronous method to fetch all doctors from API, handle errors, and update the list.

methods.name: _extractList
methods.description: Internal method to extract list data from varied API responses.

methods.name: _humanizeError
methods.description: Formats error objects into human-readable messages.
